data.name: Magic Flute
data.detailed_description:
Something for the heart, something for the mind. “Magic Flute” is a puzzle-based adventure game that will challenge your wits while enchanting you with a magical vision of a world full of wonders. Within it, the players will discover 32 spatial puzzles placed in a beautiful scenery of Mozart’s classic opera. Making their way through, they will be following a story of a journey into the unknown, bravery and – of course – love!

• A puzzle game featuring music and the story of ‘The Magic Flute’.
• 32 diverse, fun levels that can be completed in more than one way.
• A professional voice actor narrating the game to bring more depth to the story.
• Art direction inspired by the Tokyo production and set design, directed by Amon Miyamoto.
• 3 playable characters who need to work together to overcome all the devious puzzles.
• Beautiful cinematic cutscenes complementing the magical tale.

The Tokyo staging of “Magic Flute” by the renowned stage director Amon Miyamoto opened up the audience to a whole new, video game-inspired vision of opera. One of its highlight features was a multimedia projection bringing the magic to life. The Poland-based team of its authors now invites you into a journey that in a unique way combines the modern world of video games with the magical realm of opera.

***DISCLAIMER: Game's interface is NOT optimized for Apple RETINA displays.

data.short_description: Enter the Kingdom of the Queen of the Night. Start your journey through the lands of mystery and magic as prince Tamino. Choose your steps wisely, build your path avoiding traps, deadly serpents or earth quakes. But know no fear, lose no hope and remember that you are the master of your own path.

reviews.review:
On the surface, [i]Magic Flute[/i] seems like a simple puzzle game, however, once you begin to play you’re met with beautiful music and striking imagery. The story is based on the opera of the same name by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. The visuals are inspired by director Amon Miyamoto’s production of the opera which was in turn inspired by video games, using multimedia projections to bring the story to life. All this being said, you do not have to be a fan of opera, Mozart or even know anything about the story itself to enjoy this game. It’s a good stand alone interpretation of the original piece.

A young prince named Tamino finds himself lost in an unknown land being chased by a giant snake. He is rescued by three witches then meets Papageno, a bird catcher. After this brief introduction, the story gets underway.  The pair meet the Queen of Night, who gives Tamino a magical flute and sends the prince and the bird catcher on a journey to rescue her daughter, Pamina. The game follows the story of the opera, it is filled with adventure, plot twists as well as romance. The story is skillfully told through narration and cut scenes as you play each level of the puzzle game.

The game has thirty two stages of puzzle fun to explore and three characters you can play as; Tamino, Papageno and Pamina. The basic game mechanic is moving blocks to help a character reach the exit in a level. The levels are 3D so sometimes it takes looking at the problem at different angles to figure out to succeed. As to be expected, the game becomes more challenging the higher the level, introducing different aspects like crumbling platforms, ladders and new enemies. The game can be a bit hard at times but not in a frustrating way.

You’re treated to splendid music as you play the game, as to be expected of a title based on an opera. If you enjoy classical music then you will find it easy to immerse yourself in this experience. There is nothing bad I can say about the audio in this game, it’s top notch. As mentioned before, the visual are based on Amon Miyamoto’s production of the opera, everything is larger than life while also being simplistic with clean lines. It gives the game a very modern aesthetic which works well for a video game.

This may not be a game for everyone, [i]Magic Flute[/i] is a unique puzzle game telling a classic story. It’s calming and good to play when you need a break between other games. I highly enjoyed the experience, especially the music and how nice it made me feel. Even at full price it is affordable and it also has Steam achievements.  I recommend picking up this title if you wish to try something different.
